commands.review_summary:
The PR adds stdout/stderr readable-stream error handling and idempotent stdio shutdown to the Codex Supervisor JSON-RPC client, plus mocked and real-child regression coverage.

PR surface: Source +13, Tests +147. Total +160 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. by source and branch regression proof rather than a live failing current-main run: current main lacks stdout/stderr `error` listeners, and the PR drives a real child pipe read failure through the stdio transport.

target.title: fix(codex-supervisor): handle stdout/stderr stream errors in stdio transport
target.body:
## Summary

- add stdout/stderr `error` handlers for Codex Supervisor stdio JSON-RPC transport
- reuse the existing transport failure path and close the stdio child process on readable stream failure
- make stdio `close()` idempotent with a `closing` guard, so a stream error plus the initialization-failure cleanup cannot send duplicate shutdown signals to the child
- cover the stream-error path with a real spawned `node` child driven through the real stdio transport in a focused regression test
- collision check: `extensions/codex-supervisor/src/json-rpc-client.ts` has open PR #88550, but that diff is isolated to WebSocket compression; no open PR was found for the stdio stdout/stderr stream-error issue

## Verification

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex-supervisor/src/json-rpc-client.test.ts` — passed; 1 file, 2 tests passed
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/codex-supervisor/src/json-rpc-client.ts extensions/codex-supervisor/src/json-rpc-client.test.ts` — all files correctly formatted
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/codex-supervisor/src/json-rpc-client.ts extensions/codex-supervisor/src/json-rpc-client.test.ts` — no findings
- mutation check: bypassing the `closing` guard made the focused test fail with `expected "kill" to be called 1 times, but got 2 times`; restoring the guard made the same test pass

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: Codex Supervisor stdio stdout/stderr readable stream failures route through connection failure and child shutdown without duplicate close/kill.
Real environment tested: local Linux Node 22.22 source checkout; the regression test drives the real exported `connectCodexAppServerEndpoint` stdio transport with a real spawned `node` child and real pipe-backed stdout/stderr.
Exact steps or command run after this patch: the test destroys the parent-side stdout/stderr Readable with an error while the real child is alive, then verifies the connection failure and shutdown chain; command: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex-supervisor/src/json-rpc-client.test.ts`.
Evidence after fix: the real-child regression asserts connection rejection with the readable-stream error, exactly one SIGTERM, and child close `{ code: 143, signal: null }` through the transport shutdown path.
Observed result after fix: `Test Files 1 passed (1); Tests 2 passed (2)`.
What was not tested: a live Codex app-server binary; the proof uses a deterministic real Node stdio child through the same OpenClaw stdio transport. No OS-generated parent Readable error is claimed, because stdio pipe close/kill normally surfaces as EOF/`close` rather than a parent read-side `error`.
